body:
**What changed**
- **Settings that a mod makes:** some script mods write their settings file into `~mods` at their first game start, such as Auto Collect Loot's `PBZAutoCollect.txt`. The manager now takes that file into the mod, at its start and when the game closes. An update keeps your settings, an uninstall backs them up, and **Show files** no longer lists the file. Thanks to CooperZhuang (#17).
- **Fix:** a settings file in `~mods` that comes with a script mod, such as PBZ-SpeakerHighlight's, was still left out when the download has a folder of its own on top. It now installs with the mod.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_1.6.3.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
